CustomField.description: Division revenue as a percent of parent total. Spec Section 5.1. Multiplied by 100 because Percent formula fields display the raw value (not auto-scaled); produces the spec expected 46.9 percent. Null renders as a dash on the console.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISBLANK(Parent.Parent_Revenue_T12M__c), Parent.Parent_Revenue_T12M__c = 0 ), null, Division_Revenue_T12M__c / Parent.Parent_Revenue_T12M__c * 100 )
CustomField.label: Revenue Concentration %
